crossRefs.note: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies…
They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they…
“Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter…
Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity, and speak lies. They conceive mischief…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says Yahweh.
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
“Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand…
Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

translations.web: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
translations.bsb: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
translations.kjv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
translations.asv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
